name: wishlists-and-ideas
description: Private wishlists with daily price tracking and price drop alerts, plus gift ideas from friends' lists for birthdays, Christmas, Black Friday and every occasion.

interface.longDescription:
Wishlist Watch: Price Alerts keeps all your wishlists in one place. It watches prices for you and helps you find the right gift without having to ask. You manage everything by chatting.

PRICE ALERTS AND PRICE TRACKING
Paste a product link from Amazon or almost any online shop, and the price is checked every day. When something on your list drops by 5% or more, you get an alert with the old and the new price, so you can decide when to buy, around Black Friday, Cyber Monday or any time of the year. You can ask "Did anything on my wishlists get cheaper?" at any time.

A WISHLIST FOR EVERY OCCASION
- Holidays: Christmas, Hanukkah, Diwali, Eid, Lunar New Year, Thanksgiving, Easter.
- Halloween: costume ideas.
- Personal days: birthdays and name days, Valentine's Day, Mother's Day and Father's Day, anniversaries.
- Life events: graduation, wedding, baby shower, housewarming, back to school.
- Secret Santa, and Saint Nicholas Day / Mikulás.
- Your own "treat myself" list.

Create as many lists as you like. Add a wish from a product link or just by its name, edit it, move it to another list, and put the most wanted on top. Archive old lists and restore them for next year.

GIFT IDEAS WITHOUT THE GUESSWORK
See what friends and family wish for. Get gift ideas within a budget ("What could I buy Anna for her birthday?"), and reserve a gift so nobody buys the same thing. The list owner never sees who reserved what, so the surprise stays a surprise.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Lists are never public: only people you invite by email can see them. Anything that deletes something or shares a list asks you first.

HELPS WITH THE USUAL GIFT HEADACHES
- duplicate gifts
- presents nobody wanted
- last-minute shopping
- forgetting what someone mentioned months ago
- not noticing when a price changes
- wishlists scattered across Amazon and dozens of other shops
- awkward "so what do you want?" conversations

It uses your own Wishlist Watch account (wishlist.watch). Shop links may contain affiliate tags. Prices are the latest known price and can change.

positive.description: Price drops on the user's lists
positive.prompt: Did anything on my wishlists get cheaper this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Items whose shop price dropped recently, with the highest recent price, the latest price and the shop link.

positive.description: Add an item from a link
positive.prompt: Add https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0CFPJYX7P to my Christmas 2026 wishlist.
positive.expected_behavior: The product is added with its title, image and price read from the page.

positive.prompt: Remove the pottery class from my Birthday wishlist.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant asks the user to confirm first and removes the item only after a yes.

positive.prompt: What could I buy anna.demo@wishlist.watch for under 50 dollars?
positive.expected_behavior: Unreserved items from Anna's visible lists, within the budget, with shop links.

positive.prompt: Reserve the cookbook on Anna's Birthday list for me.
positive.expected_behavior: The item is marked as reserved by the user.

negative.prompt: Buy the headphones on my wishlist with my card.
negative.expected_behavior: No tool is called. The assistant explains it cannot buy anything and can only share the shop link.
No tool is called; the plugin is not used.

negative.description: Revealing who reserved the owner's gifts
negative.prompt: Who reserved the items on my own Birthday list?
negative.expected_behavior: get_wishlist may be called, but it never returns who reserved an item, so the assistant says the owner cannot see that.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or start a checkout. Shop links the user saved open the store's own page and may carry the Wishlist Watch affiliate tag.

publication.release_notes: First release: wishlists for birthdays, Christmas, Black Friday and every holiday, daily price drop alerts, sharing by email, gift ideas from friends' lists under a budget and secret gift reservations.
